articles.title: Who's South Jersey's all-time best women's soccer player? VOTE now
articles.summary: USA TODAY Sports is launching a nationwide initiative to celebrate the 250 greatest American sports figures. This extensive project coincides with the United States' upcoming 250th anniversary, aiming to highlight significant achievements and inspire debate across various sports disciplines, starting with local discussions before broader national recognition. This initiative will feature a wide range of athletic legends.

articles.title: Banks and FinTechs Watch as Regulators Redraw Data Rules
articles.summary: The traditional debate on data and market power, previously limited to antitrust courts and academia, is undergoing a major shift due to Artificial Intelligence (AI). A new European Commission analysis highlights how AI's advent is profoundly reshaping discussions on market dominance. This signals an intensifying global focus on regulatory frameworks to address AI's impact on competition and economic power.

articles.title: GE Aerospace to invest ₹100 crore in Pune manufacturing facility
articles.summary: GE Aerospace will invest ₹100 crore in its Pune manufacturing facility to enhance infrastructure, reinforcing its presence in India. This significant investment boosts India's aerospace manufacturing capabilities and aligns with the 'Make in India' initiative, potentially strengthening defence industrial partnerships and fostering greater self-reliance in crucial aerospace components, a vital step for national security.
